scope: Temporary homes, isolated QA profiles, real shell launcher with a fake LOVE executable, and an installed maintenance package in a temporary home; no real ROMs or player profiles.

fixes.cause: Read-side pinning did not recognize the exact legacy LOVE profile scopes used by the selective collector.
fixes.change: Borrow the same outer profile lock through profile_scope, without granting legacy profiles writable import registration.

fixes.cause: Whole-directory import accounting/removal bypassed the existing mixed-tree protection.
fixes.change: Share a protected generated-target iterator between accounting and removal; preserve model/source/save/keep trees and untouched completeness markers.

fixes.cause: Test referred to Start.command, which is absent in this fork.
fixes.change: Exercise the real scripts/run.sh, asserting inherited descriptors, QA identity and argument forwarding including spaces.

additionalCoverage: Legacy and modern read scopes block collection until readers release their shared locks.
Readonly legacy source pinning cannot grant writer ownership.
Clean generated assets can be removed alongside protected model data; only then is the completeness marker invalidated.
Source, save and keep subtrees are tested independently.
The installed maintenance package includes qa_love_storage.py and passes its isolated startup smoke test.
